points: CVE-2026-104935, CVSS 8.6: unauthenticated remote attackers can bypass authentication and run commands
Ivanti reports exploitation 'to a limited extent'; its advisory came out on 13 October
BSI rates the warning as high criticality (version 1.0, 14 October)
take: Another remote-access appliance is under active attack. Operators of Ivanti VPN gateways should check exposure and apply Ivanti's fixes or mitigations now.
title: BSI: Ivanti Connect Secure zero-day exploited, attackers bypass sign-in
